title: Letter to the Bishops of Libya and the Pentapolis
edition: PG 77; Ad episcopos Libyae et Pentapoleos
blurb: Cyril of Alexandria writes to the bishops of Libya and the Pentapolis after monks from the Thebaid report hasty ordinations. He asks them to examine every candidate's life before ordaining him, and to baptize and give communion to catechumens and penitents who are near death. A fresh English translation from the Greek.

text_history.method: A fresh English translation made from the Greek text printed in PG 77. No published English version was used for its wording.
